contract_term.value: Agreement in effect from date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, with an option to renew for up to one additional year, and a further option to renew for one additional year thereafter, for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.
contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County (the County) is seeking proposals for its ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP. The RFP is a multi-stage, Negotiated Request for Proposal procurement process to select a Preferred Proponent with whom to negotiate a contract for the provision of the Deliverables.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is an invitation by Rocky View County (the “County”) to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County’s ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is one of five (5) criteria evaluated on a 0-5 scale carrying a 25% weighting. The pricing scoring formula is: {(Submitted cost / Lowest cost) * Weight i.e. 25%}. Pricing is submitted on a separate Pricing Schedule (Section F of Appendix D) as a separate digital file from the technical proposal; the person-hour schedule in the technical proposal must NOT include pricing details. Rates must be in Canadian ($) funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except applicable sales taxes, which should be itemized separately, and all-inclusive of labour, equipment, material, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, overhead, and other costs. A modular pricing template is provided in Appendix C.
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is one of five (5) criteria of the RFP that proponents will be evaluated on for which points will be awarded on a scale of 0 to 5 and will carry a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score.  A complete list of the rated criteria including description, maximum number of points, and weighting for each criterion is set out in Section C of Appendix D of this RFP.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.

vendor_experience_required.value: Project Manager (and back-up): minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) years; preference for PMI or post-secondary academic project management certification. Project team members: minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) years. Client references: minimum of three (3) (preferably public sector) client references for similar/identical services within the last seven (7) years. No overall minimum years of company operation or project count is stated for the firm as a whole; the only numeric requirements are the per-role experience minimums above.
vendor_experience_required.quote: (a) The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. (b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

value: County information provided in connection with the RFP is the sole property of the County, must be treated as confidential, must not be used for any purpose other than replying to the RFP and performance of any subsequent contract, must not be disclosed without prior written authorization, and must be returned immediately upon request.

Proponents must identify any information in their proposal supplied in confidence for which confidentiality is to be maintained by the County; the County will maintain that confidentiality except as required by law or court order, and will disclose proposals on a confidential basis to County advisers retained to advise or assist with the RFP process, including evaluation.

The proponent agrees that information provided in the proposal, even if identified as supplied in confidence, may be disclosed where required by law or by order of a court or tribunal, and consents to disclosure on a confidential basis to County advisers retained to advise or assist with the RFP process, including evaluation.
data_security_requirements.quote: All information provided by or obtained from the County in any form in connection with this RFP either before or after the issuance of this RFP (a) is the sole property of the County and must be treated as confidential; (b) is not to be used for any purpose other than replying to this RFP and the performance of any subsequent contract for the deliverables; (c) must not be disclosed without prior written authorization from the County; and (d) must be returned by the proponent to the county immediately upon the county's request.
